title: CNRP-associated protest near Chinese Embassy over alleged Chinese military presence and domestic political rights
location: Near the Chinese Embassy, Phnom Penh
scope: Local embassy-area groups; part of broader anniversary mobilization, but no evidence that separately located gatherings were one continuous crowd
participants_original: CamboJA says roughly 100 protesters; Reuters calls the action small without a figure; VOD search metadata gives a much lower estimate.
threshold_50_evidence: Conflicting contemporary descriptions: CamboJA reports roughly 100 at/approaching the embassy; Reuters describes a small group without count; VOD search-only snippet indicates around 12. No shared estimate can be selected confidently.
